title: Reva
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: Reva served the Inquisitorius as the Third Sister, and was known for her unbridled ambition. Reva's motivations extended beyond the other Inquisitors. Present at the Jedi Temple during Darth Vader's slaughter, Reva blames Obi-Wan Kenobi for the massacre and means to execute her revenge.
